site_hero.title: Who carries non-firm power risk — and who is prepared to underwrite it.
site_hero.lede: Reindustrialisation runs on affordable power. The queue is ~125 GW deep; firmness is now a register fact. This index scores carriers, MGAs, brokers, assets and reinsurers on two axes — Exposure and Preparedness — and reduces each to a Margin of Safety.

welcome_modal.title: Non-Firm Power Risk Index
welcome_modal.subtitle: UK insurance market · interruptible grid power
welcome_modal.body: Two scored axes — Exposure and Preparedness — reduce to a Margin of Safety. Every rating traces to a register, filing, or cited source.
welcome_modal.footnote: Scores below the publication gate are marked PROVISIONAL.
welcome_modal.tip: Search the universe, then click any entity for the full decomposition.
